pixel_audit.scope: Grouped audit of architectural connection topology only; no metric reconstruction.

pixel_evidence.observed_result: The dark two-slope roof/eave boundary continuously caps the upper boundary of the pale P1 facade; no gap or intervening assembly is visible along the facade top.
pixel_evidence.provenance: Direct 808 inspection of public benchmark P1 pixels; new evidence, not a rewrite of obs_p1_roof_edge or obs_p1_front_wall.

pixel_evidence.observed_result: The stair flight and terrace-side region are visible in the same local scene, but the stair upper continuation is interrupted/occluded by the pale junction/projecting-volume sector before a common landing or shared terrace edge can be seen.
pixel_evidence.provenance: Direct 808 inspection of public benchmark P3 pixels; preserves 794/807 observations and tests only the connection.

pixel_evidence.observed_result: Stair and terrace occupy compatible neighboring levels, but the would-be junction is hidden by opaque wall/parapet and vegetation; no landing, common edge, or continuous guard/parapet into the terrace is directly visible.
pixel_evidence.provenance: Direct 808 inspection of public benchmark P4 pixels; does not alter the prior 796 NOT_OBSERVABLE termination result.

pixel_evidence.observed_result: The raised deck/railing assembly reaches the pale rear building sector and the deck is visibly carried by posts below; the image supports a local building-sector connection but not assignment of that sector to the P1 HOUSE face.
pixel_evidence.provenance: Direct 808 inspection of public benchmark P4 pixels, combined only with already persisted obs_p4_terrace/obs_p4_rear_wall context.

pixel_evidence.observed_result: P5 repeats the distinctive local configuration visible in P3: pale sloping-roof wall with tall upper opening, forked palm/tree, pale projecting volume with broad dark opening, diagonal solid stair parapet, and wooden terrace continuing to the right. This supports correspondence of the local architectural sector without assigning it to the P1 front face.
pixel_evidence.provenance: Direct 808 cross-view inspection of public benchmark P3 and P5 pixels; correspondence evidence only.

pixel_evidence.observed_result: P2 exposes a pale wall capped by a dark sloping roof/eave with chimney/roof context compatible with P1, but no uniquely shared opening or continuous corner is visible strongly enough to establish physical face identity.
pixel_evidence.provenance: Direct 808 cross-view inspection of public benchmark P1 and P2 pixels; compatibility is not physical identity.
